title: Light bulb with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow rays -->
  <g stroke='#FFE66D' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='4' x2='50' y2='12'/>
    <line x1='26' y1='10' x2='31' y2='17'/>
    <line x1='74' y1='10' x2='69' y2='17'/>
    <line x1='12' y1='28' x2='19' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='88' y1='28' x2='81' y2='32'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Bulb glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='28' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='28' fill='#FFD93D' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Glass highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='32' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFF8C4' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='66' width='24' height='10' rx='3' fill='#C8D6E5'/>
  <!-- Screw base -->
  <rect x='36' y='74' width='28' height='14' rx='4' fill='#8FA5B8'/>
  <!-- Base stripes -->
  <line x1='36' y1='79' x2='64' y2='79' stroke='#B0C4D4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='84' x2='64' y2='84' stroke='#6E8499' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Bottom cap -->
  <rect x='42' y='86' width='16' height='6' rx='3' fill='#5A7089'/>
  <!-- Face: eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='4' fill='#3D3D6B'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='4' fill='#3D3D6B'/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M40 52 Q50 62 60 52' stroke='#3D3D6B' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FF9B9B' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
